extraction.name: Self-Contradictory Instructions (SCI)
extraction.description: Self-Contradictory Instructions (SCI) is a multimodal benchmark for evaluating large multimodal models on detecting conflicting instructions. It comprises 20,000 self-contradictory instructions, evenly distributed between language-language and vision-language paradigms, covering 8 tasks.
extraction.creator: Jin Gao (Shanghai Jiao Tong University); Lei Gan (Fudan University); Yuankai Li (Fudan University); Yixin Ye (Shanghai Jiao Tong University); Dequan Wang (Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory)
extraction.citeAs: Jin Gao, Lei Gan, Yuankai Li, Yixin Ye, and Dequan Wang. Dissecting Dissonance: Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models Against Self-Contradictory Instructions. arXiv:2408.01091v2, 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The benchmark was constructed using an automatic dataset creation framework, AutoCreate, which starts from a small batch of manually input seeds and iteratively uses generators, decorators, and cleaners, with human experts and LLMs double-checking quality; for one task, SemanticConflict, images were retrieved from the ImageNet dataset.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Manual Human Curator; Software Collection; Secondary Data analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: A small batch of manually input seeds and, for SemanticConflict, images retrieved from the ImageNet dataset (including the ImageNet-1k validation set).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: SCI was created with an automatic dataset creation framework (AutoCreate) using programs and large language models; a small batch of manually input seeds was used, generators/decorators/cleaners produced conflicting instruction examples, and both human experts and LLMs double-checked quality, with human experts rigorously checking the final AutoCreate-generated dataset and manually selecting SCI-Base and SCI-Core subsets.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Generated data were filtered by a cleaner, double-checked by human experts and LLMs for quality, and manually refined/selected into SCI-Base (10%) and SCI-Core (1%) subsets.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: we only include language-language and vision-language paradigms; no fine-grained control is introduced to determine the conflict degree; we do not provide a detailed study on the attention mechanism of large multimodal models when confronted with conflict instructions
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: It provides researchers and practitioners with a standardized platform to assess and enhance LMMs’ ability to navigate conflicting instructions, advancing human-computer interaction and communication technologies; The AutoCreate framework facilitates the creation of diverse instruction datasets, promoting inclusivity in AI research; By improving dissonance detection, our approach boosts LMM performance and fosters trust and reliability in AI systems, essential for societal integration
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: evaluate Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) regarding their ability to detect conflicting commands; assess and enhance LMMs’ ability to navigate conflicting instructions
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The cleaner removes data that does not meet quality standards; for V-L conflicts, the image caption is modified to introduce a conflict; FigureConflict manipulates the numerical data by changing the maximum value to the minimum value; GeometricConflict modifies a phrase to refer to a non-existent object; SemanticConflict substitutes the correct label in the questions with some similar but different objects; subsets SCI-Core and SCI-Base are selected manually from SCI-All.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The Cleaner removes data that does not meet quality standards, and the resulting high-quality dataset is then refined to extract new seeds for re-entry into the seed pool.
